study_description: Writers and thinkers Philip K. Dick read, argued with, and absorbed into his own vocabulary. Each topic tracks a single interlocutor across the fiction, the Exegesis, and the correspondence, and holds on to the places where Dick changed his mind about them.

topics.card_description: Burroughs's word virus, adopted by Dick in September 1976 and argued with until his death — across 38 Exegesis passages, 14 letters and one interview.
